 Manzambi Ahead of Showdown with Yamal's Barça – Will the Swiss Player Strike Again?
 00:54 Emery über Manzambi: «Er bringt viel Qualität mit, aber...»
 Aston-Villa-Trainer Unai Emery hat fast nur Lob übrig für seinen Schützling Johan Manzambi. Five teams remain undefeated after three rounds of the Champions League. Two of them are in action on Tuesday: PSG visits Villarreal, and Aston Villa faces FC Barcelona.
 Keystone-SDA 
 Today at 05:00 • Today at 11:29 Aston Villa should once again be able to count on Johan Manzambi for their match against FC Barcelona (9 p.m., live on blue Sport), after he missed the last Champions League match due to injury. In his only Champions League appearance to date, the Geneva native scored right away (video below) and also provided an assist in the 6-0 win over Fenerbahçe. Villa coach Unay Emery is very pleased with his player, as he made clear at the press conference (video above).

 A Tough Test for Aston Villa
 Last weekend, too, the 21-year-old showed his best side and set up a goal in the Premier League. Manzambi and his team now face a real test against Barcelona. Although the Catalans suffered their first league loss following their 2-4 defeat to PSG, Hansi Flick’s team made an impressive comeback over the weekend with a 6-1 victory over Alavés.
 00:38 Along with Aston Villa, Paris Saint-Germain is also undefeated in the Champions League. Before their victory over Barcelona, coach Luis Enrique’s team had already made a strong statement with a 4-2 win over Manchester City. Next up is Villarreal, which has lost two of its three Champions League matches so far—though the Spanish side put up a tenacious fight in both the 2–3 loss to Borussia Dortmund and the 3–4 loss to Liverpool.
 Neuer and Olise Back in Training
 Somewhat surprisingly, FC Bayern Munich has only one win to its credit so far, along with two draws. The match against Atlético Madrid now offers the team led by Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane the chance to add to its point total.
 It appears that the German record champions can count on star forward Michael Olise and goalie Manuel Neuer. The duo was on the field during Munich’s final training session. Olise had been substituted in the closing stages of Saturday’s 2-2 Bundesliga showdown against Borussia Dortmund due to knee problems. Neuer had missed the entire classic match against BVB due to a foot injury.
